coverage.notes: Validates representative client-side signup guardrails such as invalid email, short password, and missing terms agreement without submitting a real registration request.

preconditions: The local frontend and backend E2E servers are reachable.
The run starts in an anonymous state with no active session.
The register page is available without Google auth prerequisites.
assertions: The register form is visible at /auth/register.
The submit button stays disabled for invalid email and short password input.
Representative validation feedback appears for invalid email and short password.
The submit button only becomes enabled when the form is otherwise valid and terms are agreed.
The user cannot proceed while the terms agreement is unchecked.
notes: Keeps signup validation coverage isolated from mailbox-driven verification, duplicate-email handling, and successful registration acceptance.
